one_line: Anthropic secured gas-fired generators, Nvidia's board launched a probe into CEO Jensen Huang, and AI music platforms faced fresh lawsuits.

themes.title: Datacenter expansion and power sourcing
themes.text: Anthropic purchased $3.4 billion in gas-fired generators, while Envision Group opened its gigawatt-scale Galaxy AI datacenter in Inner Mongolia.

stories.headline: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas-fired generators in $3.4B deal
Envision Group opens gigawatt-scale Galaxy AI datacenter in Inner Mongolia

themes.title: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

stories.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot

themes.title: Music rights holders sue Suno
themes.text: Elvis Presley Enterprises and Eminem publisher Eight Mile Style filed lawsuits against AI music generator Suno over copyright infringement and voice cloning.

stories.headline: Elvis and Eminem rights holders file lawsuits against AI music platform Suno
